decision_rule: PASS only for explicit Test 6 PASS in both n_rs_seq=0/8 modes, same-destination valid control and stale mutation detected with named mechanism, >=2 exact-symbol in-test mapped-library witnesses per mode, and sealed build/model custody. Any missing control, skipped or invalid execution is INVALID, not a kernel defect. Build is pinned by full build receipt, executable and DSOs; the model SHA was preverified out of grant and in-grant checks use stat metadata only. Additionally, the captured inferior must have an independently recorded normal zero exit and continue must return without a live inferior.
